entries.title: Blacklist hard block, Data backup and Shop Price
items: Added full blacklist hard-block behavior for revoked users.
Blacklisted accounts can no longer open EMCE menus, use /emc client commands, trigger EMCE keybinds or interact with free/premium tools.
Hidden EMCE HUD overlays for blacklisted accounts, including radar, weather/vote, mining session, waypoints and EMCE popups.
Added a red blacklist warning message in chat: You have been blacklisted. If you think this is a mistake, contact QJWIN on the French Discord.
Updated the Cloudflare entitlement worker to verify player town and nation through the EarthMC API before applying whitelist/blacklist rules.
Extended blacklist checks to block both premium entitlement and RP Items Sacred unlock access.
Added Settings > Data & mode export/import columns for local JSON backups.
Added category backups for residents, towns, nations, favorites, waypoints, TP lists, Shop Price and config/keybinds.
Added the manual premium Shop Price tool with Add/Update, Town records and Global item stats tabs.
Added Shop Price item catalog support for all vanilla items plus Premium Egg, Giant Gold Crate, Gold Crate and Mystery Crate.
Fixed Shop Price layout spacing across every tab so section titles no longer overlap the first field or description.
Kept resource-pack textures visible for blacklisted users while disabling all EMCE client logic.

entries.title: Launcher compatibility, Godthab UI pack and GUI polish
items: Added a non-EarthMC server guard so EMCE does not run EarthMC API refreshes, automatic commands or server-specific logic while connected to another server.
Fixed launcher compatibility issues seen with Feather and non-vanilla launchers by hardening local JSON cache writes and corrupted last_success.json recovery.
Integrated the Godthab Network resource pack assets used by EMCE, including GUI backgrounds, rank glyphs, server UTF-8 icons, GUI button textures and item model definitions.
Fixed missing GUI button icons by adding the Paper and Breeze Rod item definitions plus the related GUI item model files required by Minecraft 1.21.11.
Changed vanilla container foreground labels such as chest titles and inventory labels to gold so they remain readable on the Godthab GUI textures.
Improved RP custom item handling to reduce visual ghost items after moving renamed/custom-textured items between inventory slots.
Improved anvil rename handling so custom-textured items no longer force the first assigned custom name while the player is editing the name.
Added chat badge capture for EarthMC chat lines so resident profiles can be enriched with badges seen before the nation/town/player tag.
Added Premium Egg support in the EMC Store screen with the new icon and updated store information.
Cleaned EMC Store cards by removing duplicated category labels from Premium, Mystery Crates, Queue Priority and Premium Egg while keeping the Copium Badge availability timer.

entries.title: Raid Helper and Townless refresh update
items: Renamed Snip Tool to Raid Helper and updated the main menu subtitle to EarthMC Professional Toolkit.
Added Raid Helper tabs for Town For Sale, Townless Gold, Outsider Perm and Overclaim Town.
Added Overclaim Town detection using current claims versus calculated claim limits.
Blocked Townless Gold as Coming soon while a safe age/playtime detection method is redesigned.
Restored the fast Townless cache method based on online players and player town status.
Decoupled Townless auto-refresh from the heavier residents updater so townless.json can refresh independently.
Updated website metadata and the update worker to point to version 0.6.4.

entries.title: RP Items texture and material fixes
items: Added the latest RP item texture fixes for the extra RP packs.
Fixed additional RP item model references to reduce missing pink and black previews.
Changed drink RP items back to water-filled potions as their rename material while protecting vanilla potion textures.
Removed the Branza RP item because its model was still missing texture data.
Fixed the propeller hat texture animation metadata so it renders correctly.
Removed the Textiles tab from RP Items and merged textile entries into Objects.
Adjusted RP Items tab sizing so tab labels stay inside their buttons.

entries.title: RP Items, Church access and security update
items: Renamed RP Hats to RP Items.
Added RP Items categories with tabs for hats, weapons, objects, food, textiles and church items.
Added vanilla material cards next to Copy so players know which item must be renamed.
Added protected Church RP Items access with a password popup validated by the entitlement worker.
Church access now resets when leaving the RP Items page.
Improved RP Items UI sizing, English tab labels and compact Premium reference display.
Fixed RP item preview model wrappers for custom skins.
Town map and Nation map are now Premium-gated through entitlement features.

entries.title: Mining Session and RP Hats release
items: Added the Mining Session HUD for premium mining workflows.
Mining Session now tracks elapsed time, total blocks mined and real ore blocks mined during the active session.
Gold tracking now separates mined gold blocks from gold available in the player inventory and ender chest.
Gold in inventory is displayed as a gold-equivalent value, including raw gold, gold ore and silk-touched ore sources.
Added the RP Hats menu in Extras.
Added hat preview cards and a Copy button to copy the exact hat name.
RP Hats can be applied by renaming a carved pumpkin in an anvil.
Added 131 RP hats from QOL and the Catholic Church Pack.
Website metadata, download link and update worker now point to the 0.6.1 build.

entries.title: Advertising and Townless refresh hotfix
items: Auto Advertising no longer sends a message immediately after login.
Turning Auto ON now waits the normal six-minute delay before sending.
Townless refresh now rebuilds the list from fresh API data.
Players who joined a town should no longer remain stuck in Townless after refresh.
Website metadata and update worker now point to the 0.5.4 build.
